usedFor: Airtable is where you plan offers in a table; WooCommerce is the store that honors them. A “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable can run “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce, turning a row into a live discount code.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: It lets you manage promotions in a table and publish each one to the store, and “Create Coupon” does the actual setup.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” is polling and fires on edits as well as new rows, so one record can run twice and try to create the same coupon again. Add a status field to filter.
